title: Perplexity’s Personal Computer turns Windows PCs into AI agents
slides: Can a Windows PC truly think for you?
Perplexity's software installs like any other app.
It doesn't just search—it clicks, scrolls, and types.
Your spreadsheets and forms fill themselves automatically.
Test it on one repetitive task today.
thread_text:
1. Can a PC think for you?

Perplexity's AI agent downloads like any app, but executes actions on your machine.

2. It doesn’t just answer.

The software takes control: it clicks buttons, scrolls pages, and types text for you.

3. Spreadsheets fill themselves.

Your daily data entry forms and tables get populated automatically by the agent.

4. No more repetitive clicks.

One task is enough to test if the agent saves time or introduces errors.

5. Test it this week.

Pick one repetitive task in your browser. Run Perplexity on it and measure if it actually finishes.

instagram.caption:
Your Windows PC can now click, scroll, and type for you.

Perplexity just released software that turns your machine into an AI agent. It installs like a normal app, then takes control of your browser to fill spreadsheets and forms automatically. One repetitive task is all it takes to test.

For anyone who publishes content, this means daily data entry and browser admin could vanish. Your workflow gets automated without plugins.

Pick one boring task you do today. Run Perplexity on it. Does it actually finish? ⏱️🧠🤖
